One of the best things about him is his honesty—there are no fake charges or unnecessary repairs. He only fixes what’s needed, ensuring you get the best service at a fair price. If your bike or scooter suddenly breaks down, he will come to your location and get it running again.

Beyond his technical skills, his polite attitude makes the experience even better. He patiently listens to your concerns, explains the issue, and works with dedication. It’s rare to find such a knowledgeable and trustworthy mechanic who truly cares about his customers. If you need a reliable repair at an honest price, he is the one to call!

featured_reviews.name: Amol Pagare
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Night Ride to Remember – Friendship, Laughter, and Mumbai’s Magic

For the past few months, my friends and I had been planning a cycling ride across Mumbai. Life was busy, schedules never matched, and opportunities kept slipping away. But one night, without overthinking and without long discussions, one friend finally took action. He suddenly booked cycles for 10 of us—and that one decision turned into an unforgettable memory.

We gathered at Colaba Market, at a cycle rental point in Colaba. Some friends came by taxi from Central, others arrived by bus, but in the end, we all met at the same place with the same excitement in our hearts. At exactly 12:00 a.m., we started our ride.

From Colaba Market, we cycled through the quiet streets of Mumbai—towards Marine Drive, then near Grant Road and the Reliance building, Antilia. From there, we rode to Haji Ali, continued to Worli, and crossed the breathtaking Bandra–Worli Sea Link, glowing blue under the night sky. The city looked magical—calm, peaceful, and beautiful in a way we rarely see.

The cold, fresh air touched our faces as we rode together. We talked, laughed loudly, shared jokes, and enjoyed every moment like children. There was no crowd, no traffic, only empty roads, city lights, and pure happiness. Even though the ride was tough and our legs and backs started hurting, our hearts felt light and full.

We also noticed the Mumbai police on duty throughout the night—watching over the city, protecting Mumbaikars, and keeping everyone safe. It made us feel proud and grateful to be part of this city.

By 5:30 a.m., we returned to Colaba, tired but smiling, carrying memories that will stay with us forever. We then went back home to rest, not just our bodies but our happy, satisfied minds.

This ride was difficult, yes—but it was worth every pain. It gave us experience, bonding, laughter, and a story we will always remember.

We look forward to another cycling ride in the coming months. Until then, these memories will keep us smiling.

Next time, join us—and let’s create more moments together. 💙🚴‍♂️🌃

Brilliant place to get your MTB, Road Bike or a BMX for some TLC and you will not want to  service your bike anywhere else except here, that’s the quality of work I saw at Sharptune
My rims were cracked got it replaced and the spokes needed to be changed to new ones too.
Other than that all the parts were opened and cleaned, greased etc. for a smooth running. Kudos to the guys at Sharptune

featured_reviews.name: Monish Dayal
featured_reviews.review_text: This is not your average bike repair shop. The guys at Sharp Tune took my bike, stripped down to the bare frame and brought it back to me as good as new. Deepak is super knowledgeable and very helpful. Couldn't be happier with the result. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Anool Mahidharia
featured_reviews.review_text: My favourite Go-To local bike shop (LBS). Dipak is really chill, and he and his crew are extremely talented and knowledgeable.

featured_reviews.name: kimaya m
featured_reviews.review_text:
Highly recommend SharpTune to anyone who owns a high-end bicycle. Dipak Panchal is the best in the business!

Dipak is knowledgeable about all aspects of bicycle maintenance and repair. He uses high-quality parts.
If you are looking for a bicycle service technician who knows what they are doing, then Dipak is the person to see.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: Had some pretty serious issues and risky ones as well with my rear suspension and Deepak Bhaiya kept his cool and explained everything to me also tried his best to get it resolved. While the problem isn’t fully resolved due to lacks of parts available for my bike in India I’m pretty happy to see someone who is excited and drived towards cycling and to help others. I would recommend this place to everyone and anyone who needs his cycle to work in pristine condition 🙌🏼. It also doesn’t drill holes in your pocket so that’s a win win.

featured_reviews.name: Yash Chudasama
featured_reviews.review_text:
A one stop location for all your Cycle requirements, These people know about cycles in and out. Here I am not talking basic cycling, be it Mountain Biking, FlatLand BMX, Road Cycles, Skateboarding and many more.
To know more contact them or visit the store.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya salve
featured_reviews.review_text: Deepak is Dr. Asthana😂😊 a well know and passionate surgeon for your bike and Dean for BMX University ( SHARPTUNE ) he works with A team Bharat. Best place to buy and service your bike

Purchase with confidence knowing that we provide free after-sales service. Explore a playful world where your children can embark on cycling adventures with our rental service. Step into a realm of excitement, as we offer a range of soft toys, games, birthday party balloons, and themes guaranteeing endless entertainment for every occasion.

featured_reviews.name: Vishu N
featured_reviews.review_text:
“ill will “Not a “Good Will”

Worst experience ever at this cycle store!
As I walked in with my 5-year-old child, their dog suddenly ran toward us. My daughter got scared and started crying. When I asked the lady to tie up the dog, she did it very slowly and didn’t seem to care at all. It’s not just about running a business — basic humanity and concern for others matter too. Absolutely pathetic behavior… Downfall will start soon…

featured_reviews.name: Zubin Madon
featured_reviews.review_text: I've bought 2 cycles from here and various accessories. The collection here is so damn good. Very classy and quality products. Prefer these to decathlon. My latest purchase in picture. Very good prices.

featured_reviews.name: Parth Kadakia
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent shop for cycle on rent and toys and everything to buy

featured_reviews.name: Priyadarshini Dabhade
featured_reviews.review_text: French Chalet experience, wooden polished flooring, tall ceiling, walk-into a friendly family atmosphere of warmth and genuine service. Honest pricing and amazing service. It’s a sea of soft toys and kids toys, game boards, excellent maintained cycles and all accessories, buy new cycles, rent a cycle, cycle training to students and to adults all age groups. I don’t need to go any other place feel like a child in a candy store when I I walk in here🤩

featured_reviews.name: Honest Critic
featured_reviews.review_text: I didn't get the  name of who but mine and my son's hair. But she is loving jolly and understands what you actually want. Which not all hair cutting personals do. Hair is our image how we keep them which includes looks and comfort is important. That's why to understand a person first is important. Keep it up

featured_reviews.name: Kshitij Raja
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a good experience. Maybe i forgot to mention that i still need to grow my hair even longer so don’t cut too much from the top.
But I like the new cut. I will visit again once I’ve grown them long enough.
Overall a thumbs up. 👍🏽

featured_reviews.name: साहब
featured_reviews.review_text:
"All you can practice is patience when an artist is at work."

And it works for you so you can flaunt her art wherever you go while she works on another mould trying really hard to make it a masterpiece too.

Though, be prepared with your script of jokes as she loves her share of humour, might even earn you a free head massage. 😉

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Vishwa'karma
featured_reviews.review_text: Super fun hair artist, Zeeba mam.. Multi talented. Salon is easily accessible too. You name it, she got it. Good to have music running throughout, in the background. Recommended.
